'''''Around the Campfire''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a series of conflicts between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It depicted a group of friends&mdash;a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], an individual wearing a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|helmet]], a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-skinned [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] and a female [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]]&mdash;resting in a campsite around a [[Fire/Legends|campfire]]. A large structure appeared behind them.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Around the Campfire'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. It was added to the game on [[February 22]], [[2007]] as part of the ''Chapter 5: An Entertaining Enterprise'' game update. The update saw the return of camping kits and the ability to craft them to the game, which the painting was meant to signify. All players who logged in after the update was released but before the release of ''Chapter 6'' received one of these paintings. They could be used in one of the player's personal structures as decoration.<ref name="SWG" />
